notes: I changed the model from predicting nothing to a symmetric band rule: f(x)=1 exactly when |x| lies in [0.5, 1], otherwise 0. This fits every point in E1 (0.5, 1, -0.5, -1 → 1; 0, ±2, and all larger magnitudes → 0), and it generalizes to untested inputs. The exact edge behavior (whether 0.5 and 1 are inclusive) is inferred from the single boundary samples and marked as uncertain in spirit.
